plex.name: Plex
plex.desc: Connect to your Plex Media Server to sync your anime library.

sonarr.name: Sonarr
sonarr.desc: Track anime series from your Sonarr instance.

mal.name: MyAnimeList
mal.desc: Authenticate with your MyAnimeList account for watch-list data.

kometa.name: Kometa
kometa.desc: Source of the AniDB ↔ TVDB / TMDB mapping file.

app.name: App Preferences
app.desc: General application preferences and content filtering options.

Plex_Host.name: Server URL
Plex_Host.desc: Base URL of your Plex Media Server (e.g. http://localhost:32400).

Plex_Token.name: Auth Token
Plex_Token.desc: Authentication token for your Plex account.

Plex_AnimeSections.name: Anime Library IDs
Plex_AnimeSections.desc: Comma-separated Plex library section IDs that contain anime.

Sonarr_Host.name: Server URL
Sonarr_Host.desc: Base URL of your Sonarr instance (e.g. http://localhost:8989).

Sonarr_ApiKey.name: API Key
Sonarr_ApiKey.desc: API key found in Sonarr › Settings › General.

Sonarr_AnimeTags.name: Anime Tags
Sonarr_AnimeTags.desc: Comma-separated Sonarr tag names used to identify anime series.

Sonarr_RemoteUrl.name: Remote URL
Sonarr_RemoteUrl.desc: Optional public URL for Sonarr used to build series deep-links.

MAL_ApiToken.name: Access Token
MAL_ApiToken.desc: Current OAuth access token for the MyAnimeList API.

MAL_ClientId.name: OAuth Client ID
MAL_ClientId.desc: Client ID registered on the MyAnimeList developer portal.

MAL_ClientSecret.name: OAuth Client Secret
MAL_ClientSecret.desc: Client Secret registered on the MyAnimeList developer portal.

MAL_RefreshToken.name: Refresh Token
MAL_RefreshToken.desc: OAuth Refresh Token used to renew the access token automatically.

Kometa_AnimeIdsJsonUrl.name: Anime IDs JSON URL
Kometa_AnimeIdsJsonUrl.desc: URL of the Kometa Community anime_ids.json AniDB mapping file.

App_ShowNsfw.name: Show NSFW Content
App_ShowNsfw.desc: When enabled, adult and explicit content from MyAnimeList will be included in lists and statistics.

App_SyncInterval.name: Sync Interval
App_SyncInterval.desc: How often the background sync job runs to fetch new data from all sources.

App_TitleSimilarityThreshold.name: Title Search Similarity (%)
App_TitleSimilarityThreshold.desc: Minimum similarity percentage (1–100) for fuzzy title search using pg_trgm. Default: 80.
